description: This Kotlin source file defines the main composable structure of an Android app for an audiobook viewer, including navigation setup, bottom navigation bar, and screen composition functions.

classes.name: Screen
classes.description: Sealed class representing different navigation routes in the app with route paths and a helper function to create detail routes.

methods.name: AudioBookApp
methods.description: Main composable function setting up navigation, scaffold, and passing required dependencies to individual screens.

methods.name: BottomBar
methods.description: Composable function rendering the bottom navigation bar with route-based selection and navigation handling.
